transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I just have a hard time sitting still. Like, whenever I'm supposed to just sit there in the radiology suite, or in my classes... I don't know, I just feel like I'm crawling out of my skin. I've tried to just tough it out for months, but... I still end up pacing, or shifting around a lot. I always have to find some excuse to get up and move. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you had this restlessness since childhood?

Yeah... um, I guess. My parents actually still bring up these old elementary school conferences. I guess the teachers said I was... always out of my seat, or calling out. Rushing ahead before they even finished giving the directions. So... yeah, it was happening way before middle school. It's not just since my radiology training.
